'''Ral Nalmar''' was the husband of [[Emie Nalmar]], and the father of [[Elana Nalmar]]. He was also the head of the [[Nalmar Family|Nalmar crime family]] operating out of [[Genesia]]. He was killed during the attack on the [[Nalmar residence|Nalmar mansion]] perpetrated by [[Qual'om Soach]]'s forces.
